summary.headline: Post-expiry reset: October movement is sold while deferred November/December protection remains active.
key_points: October 18.5 short-movement inventory is OI-confirmed and 18.5-19 is the main regime pivot.
Large current Oct19C and Oct24-26 call demand exists, but upper supply remains concentrated at 21-22 and 28-30.
Dec22C shows very large fresh turnover and Dec30C is OI-confirmed with same-side continuation.
Exact Oct-to-Nov tail geometry is consistent with rolling tail convexity outward.
Late VIX stress reached 18.82 and Oct forward near 19.05, then partially retraced.
summary.daily_note: For SPX the regime is mixed-to-constructive below the 18.5-19 VIX/October pivot, but deferred hedge demand raises the cost of a sustained move above 19.

leave_one_out.comment: Positive headline remains positive after removing the largest structure or either of the two largest expiries; economic meaning is still expiry-dependent because call buying and put selling offset different risks.
